content: The world makes way for the man who knows whither he is going.
author: Ralph Waldo Emerson
explanation: Clear, uncompromising intention radiates an authority that parts obstacles. Hesitation invites resistance, but resolute clarity commands respect.
practicalInsight: Clarify your exact top priority before starting your workday and pursue it with steady conviction.
reflectionPrompt: How clear and unwavering is your direction in life right now?
